blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A former staff member of dismissed Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) official Henry Alcantara said the latter had collected at least P5 billion in kickbacks on behalf of certain lawmakers and other officials who served as “proponents” of flood control projects. Carlo Rivera testified before the Sandiganbayan on Tuesday as a prosecution witness at the bail hearing for the P7.4-billion plunder case against former Speaker Martin Romualdez, According to Rivera, his former boss “committed” that much amount from the funds intended for DPWH projects in Bulacan province between 2022 and 2025.
